Berkeley CS 185/285     Deep Reinforcement Learning, Decision Making, and Control             Spring 2026



                 Assignment 4: LLM Reinforcement Learning
                                     Due April 1, 11:59 PM

1 Introduction

The goal of this assignment is to learn how modern LLM reinforcement-learning post-training
works in practice. You will implement the key algorithmic pieces needed to fine-tune a base
language model with outcome rewards, and then run a small set of controlled experiments comparing
GR-REINFORCE and GRPO.
The starter code for the assignment is in:

     https://github.com/berkeleydeeprlcourse/homework_spring2026/tree/main/hw4

All experiments in this assignment are configured to run on Modal using an H100 GPU. Your
